description: This file configures internationalization (i18n) for a Vue 3 application, including loading locale messages, supporting lazy loading of translations, and managing supported locales.

methods.name: setupI18n
methods.description: Initializes the i18n instance with default and plugin locales, determines user locale, and returns the configured i18n object.

methods.name: loadLocaleMessages
methods.description: Loads locale-specific messages, merges plugin messages, and sets the active locale.

methods.name: getSupportedLocales
methods.description: Returns a list of supported locale codes by inspecting locale files.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets the active locale for the i18n instance.
